{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Structured wool-blend blazer in a deep autumn charcoal (#3e4042), tailored with wide lapels and single-button closure.  
High-waisted midi skirt in matching dark grey (#454648), pencil cut with a subtle front seam to elongate the silhouette, hem falling just above the ankle.  
Silk-blend blouse in cream white (#fdfbf7), loose fit with a cuffed neckline and button-down front tucked neatly into the skirt waist.  
Ankle boots in polished oxblood leather (#8a2c30), pointed toe with a moderate heel for elegance and stability on evening pavement.  
Delicate gold drop earrings in 14k yellow gold (#ffd700), small geometric stud necklace, and a clutch in matte black velvet.  

This outfit balances the formal requirement of the upscale restaurant setting with her desire for an open, confident look by featuring a structured blazer that frames the face rather than restricting movement. The monochromatic base of charcoal and cream creates a slimming vertical line, while the rich oxblood boots add a sophisticated pop of color that complements her warm skin tones. Fabric choices like wool-blend and silk ensure comfort through the autumn evening while maintaining the polished finish expected at a celebration."}
